meta.title: DJI drone live streaming guides — DJI Live Bridge blog
meta.description: Step-by-step guides for streaming a DJI drone live from DJI Fly to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, Kick or several platforms at once.

lead: How to take the live picture from DJI Fly to the platform you use — the settings each one needs, where to find its stream key, and what to do when it does not work.

cta.p: DJI Live Bridge is free and open source, for macOS and Windows. FFmpeg is built in, so there is nothing else to install.
